narrative_before: This is a documented CTID emulation of Wizard Spider, modelling the group's real 2020 Emotet->TrickBot->Ryuk ransomware operations (DFIR Report, CISA). The lab has a domain controller 'wizard' (10.0.0.4) and user machines 'dorothy' (10.0.0.7) and 'toto' (10.0.0.8). A phishing macro document executes Emotet on dorothy, which gains registry persistence and scrapes Outlook, collecting credentials for user bill@oz.local. Emotet RDPs into the toto host using Bill's credentials and deploys TrickBot, which performs extensive discovery and escalates privileges via Rubeus Kerberoasting to obtain the domain-admin (vfleming) credentials. Using vfleming the actor RDPs into the domain controller wizard, installs TrickBot persistence, maps AD with AdFind, and exfiltrates an ntds.dit shadow copy. Finally, mounting the C$ share of toto to stage service-killing scripts, the actor uploads and executes Ryuk from the domain controller, encrypting files recursively.

detection_moments.description: Initial access: Emotet macro document on dorothy, registry persistence, Outlook scraping of Bill's credentials.
detection_moments.evidence: 'Dorothy inadvertently activates a weaponized Emotet ... document ... downloads the initial DLL ... collect emails and contacts ... credentials from another user, bill@oz.local' - Wizard Spider Operations Flow Steps 1-3

detection_moments.description: RDP to toto with Bill's creds, TrickBot deployed, Rubeus Kerberoasting yields domain-admin (vfleming) credentials.
detection_moments.evidence: 'Emotet RDPs into the Toto host ... downloads and executes TrickBot ... escalates privileges with kerberoasting, using Rubeus ... collect encrypted credentials for the domain admin, vFleming' - Wizard Spider Operations Flow Steps 4-6

detection_moments.description: RDP to the domain controller wizard with vfleming; service-killing scripts staged on toto C$ and Ryuk executed from the DC.
detection_moments.evidence: 'the adversary RDPs into the domain controller ... mounting the C$ share of the Toto Host ... Ryuk is uploaded to the domain controller and executed from CMD ... encrypts files on its current host recursively' - Wizard Spider Operations Flow Steps 7-10

attack_path: RDP from dorothy to toto with scraped Bill credentials; TrickBot deployed - T1021.001 / T1078.002
RDP from toto to domain controller wizard with vfleming (domain admin) - T1021.001
C$ share of toto mounted from the DC to stage Ryuk and service-killing scripts - T1021.002 / T1490
ambiguities: Documented emulation of real Wizard Spider 2020 operations; year 2020 set accordingly.
Hostnames (wizard/dorothy/toto) and IPs are the plan's lab values (Wizard of Oz themed).
The dc->toto link reflects the plan mounting toto's C$ share from the DC to stage Ryuk (bidirectional use of the toto host).
